Understand Quick user subscriptions and roles
The new Quick Professional subscription maps to the Reader Pro (Professional) role, and the new Reader role with AI capabilities has similar feature set as Professional role. The new Quick Enterprise subscription maps to the Author Pro (Enterprise) and Admin Pro (Enterprise) roles. To learn more about the features included in these subscriptions, visit the Quick pricing page. Manage users.
